description: A traffic signal system for high-speed roads : TARU 3/71 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. This report describes the development of a traffic signal system for use on high speed roads. The aim of the system is to reduce the risk of driver error by minimising the chance of the traffic signals changing from green to amber while a vehicle is within the dilemma zone associated with its approach speed. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Department of Motor Transport, Traffic Accident Research Unit TARU. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
